name: @arugula-salad/loam
description: TypeScript client for loam's public API (docs/API.md): sandboxes, exec, files, ports, services, checkpoints, events, secrets.

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && tsc -p tsconfig.json && node scripts/bundle.mjs
scripts.test: npm run build && rm -rf build && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && node --test build/test/*.test.js
